{{Quote|Does Zorneth have any thookahs with meat on their bones?|A Krozurbian merchant to [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="SOR1" />}}
A '''Krozurbian merchant''' purchased a herd of [[Savorium herb|savorium]]-fed [[thookah]]s from [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Zorneth]] and subsequently supplied them to the [[Krozurbian War Council]], which ended the [[Krozurbian war]].

==Biography==
[[File:KrozurbianMerchant2.jpg|thumb|left|The merchant negotiates with Zorneth and C-3PO over Zorneth's thookahs]]
The merchant was present at market when he met with the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Zorneth]] and his [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]. The merchant negotiated with Zorneth through C-3PO to purchace Zorneth's herd of [[thookah]]s, noting that although their coats looked good, they were scrawny. Zorneth, a [[Vegetarian/Legends|vegetarian]], countered that his thookahs were for shearing and not consumption. Before their negotiations could continue, "[[Klorr Vilia|Smiley]]," an individual under Zorneth's care who had been rendered permanently euphoric and pacifistic by the effects of [[savorium herb]], was nearly kidnapped by [[Targonnian]] agents. Once "Smiley" was rescued, Zorneth decided to sell his thookah herd at a loss and depart immediately.<ref name="SOR1" />

Unbeknownst to the merchant, these thookahs had been fed with savorium, and their meat possessed the same euphoric effect as the herb itself. These thookahs were butchered and made into [[Thookah-steak|steaks]] that were fed to the [[Krozurbian War Council]], who brought an end to two centuries of [[Krozurbian war|war]] as a result.<ref name="SOR4" />

==Personality and traits==
The merchant, like other [[Krozurbian]]s, was a [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned being,<ref name="SOR1" /> but unlike several Krozurbians on the War Council,<ref name="SOR4" /> the merchant had red eyes. The merchant was an aggressive negotiator, promptly finding fault with Zorneth's thookahs and ultimately forcing the scientist to sell the herd at a loss in order for him to close the deal.<ref name="SOR1" />

==Equipment==
The merchant wore a blue [[uniform]] with gold piping on the shoulders and collar, and a triangular emblem on the left breast; wrists and feet were protected by cloth wrappings.<ref name="SOR1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Krozurbian merchant was created by [[Jan Strnad]] for his [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Droids (1995) 5|''Droids (1995)'' 5]], published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] in [[1995]]. The being was illustrated by [[Bill Hughes]].<ref name="SOR1" /> Other members of the merchant's species were depicted in a flashback panel in [[Droids (1995) 8|issue 4]], where their name, "Krozurbians," as well as the outcome of the merchant's purchase from Zorneth was established.<ref name="SOR4" />
